cards.name: Winds of Qal Sisma
cards.oracle_text:
Prevent all combat damage that would be dealt this turn.
Ferocious — If you control a creature with power 4 or greater, instead prevent all combat damage that would be dealt this turn by creatures your opponents control.

rulings.comment: If you control a creature with power 4 or greater as Winds of Qal Sisma resolves, the ferocious ability will apply. Combat damage dealt by creatures your opponents control will be prevented, even if you no longer control a creature with power 4 or greater as that damage would be dealt.

source: Scryfall Oracle/rulings subset for offline tests
